contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (8,924.31) on the p2 Summary Page, which is ALSO Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 8924.31' and its printed 'Total Contributions Received $ 8924.31', and is repeated at summary line 4
contributions.detail: 11 Schedule A rows sum to 274.31 + 250.00 + 200.00 + 1000.00 + 250.00 + 250.00 + 200.00 + 5000.00 + 1200.00 + 250.00 + 50.00 = 8,924.31 exactly = the schedule's own printed page subtotal = the schedule's printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD cell (Column A). The page-subtotal gate therefore closes at the sheet level as well as the cover level. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 8,924.31 - this is the cum==per case that the COVER_CHAIN screen documents as NORMAL for a FIRST report of a cycle (this is Ellertson's first 2012 filing, the pre-primary one), NOT a restatement, so `exact` and not `cumulative-exact`. The summary ladder is internally exact and corroborates: line 3 beginning 8,265.18 + line 4 8,924.31 = line 5 subtotal 17,189.49 as printed, minus line 6 9,759.51 = line 7 close 7,429.98 as printed.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (9,759.51) on the p2 Summary Page, which is ALSO Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 9759.51' and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received $ 9759.51', and is repeated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 15 Schedule B rows sum to 224.00 + 519.48 + 36.84 + 13.99 + 11.75 + 30.00 + 26.76 + 25.00 + 360.73 + 373.64 + 15.08 + 7989.89 + 29.10 + 56.57 + 46.68 = 9,759.51 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Column A. TWO CELLS WERE DECIDED BY THE ARITHMETIC, not by glyph re-reading (GOTCHAS: ARITHMETIC CLOSURE OUTRANKS GLYPH READING). The 200 dpi full-page read gave row 3 (Costco) as 36.88 and row 4 (FedEx Office) as 15.99, which summed to 9,761.55 - 2.04 over the printed 9,759.51. A 900 dpi crop of the amount column (pct:82.5,15.7,12,20.4@p4) RENDERED '36.84' and '13.99', and those readings close the schedule to the cent. Both the crop and the sum agree, so no cell was nudged and no delta is claimed. Column B Year-to-Date also prints 9,759.51 (first report of the cycle - see the contributions detail) and is never summed as an increment.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed exactly on BOTH sides (8,924.31 and 9,759.51). This form prints no in-kind column and no row on either schedule is marked in-kind, so the monetary-plus-in-kind convention gives the identical sums and also closes. Both conventions tested per the per-filer rule; neither is distinguishable here.
itemized.escalation_note: Ten tight crops. THREE resolved real doubt: the p4 amount column at 900 dpi in three vertical slices, which corrected 36.88 -> 36.84 and 15.99 -> 13.99 and thereby closed Schedule B to the cent; a 1600 dpi crop of the p3 row-7 date cell, which showed the filer's middle glyph is a CLOSED DOUBLE LOOP (an 8) where his own 3s elsewhere on the same page - '3/8/12' in row 1, '3301' in the row-7 address - are open-topped, so the date is kept verbatim as '5/81/12' rather than repaired to 5/31/12; and a 1600 dpi crop of the p3 row-10 name, which reads 'Jim Evens'. The remaining crops are the four geometry proofs and two column-context strips used for the field-shift screen.

FORM: the 2012 legacy_colAB blank characterised on key 9630b1c7 - '2012 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)', 4 pages, cover / SUMMARY PAGE / SCHEDULE A / SCHEDULE B, 16 ruled data rows per schedule, each schedule printing BOTH a 'Subtotal for this page' and a 'Total ... Received' line. Summary page located by its printed heading; it happens to be p2. Report type 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' ticked; amendment 'No' ticked; signed 6-18-12; TWO clerk stamps, JUN 18 PM 4:53 in the right margin and JUN 19 AM 11:26 in the For-Office-Use box. FOLIATION: this filer numbers 2/3/4 'of 4', i.e. INCLUDING the cover - the opposite of Ballard's practice in the same cycle, and one more confirmation that a page ordinal never locates the summary page (ADDENDUM A4). A FORM-LABEL CORRECTION BY THE FILER: on Schedule B he struck through the printed column heading 'Contributor' and wrote 'Payee' above it - the 2012 blank reuses Schedule A's headings on Schedule B (see the 9630b1c7 characterisation note), and this filer noticed and fixed it by hand. Handwritten corrections over struck printed values govern, so the p4 name column is read as PAYEE. BOTH SIDES CLOSE EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A figure and on each schedule's own printed subtotal and total. Column A equals Column B on both lines because this is the first report of the cycle - the documented normal case, not a restatement. PRIVACY: this era is unredacted (ADDENDUM A5) and full donor street lines are visible on Schedule A; none is carried into this record, in any field or note - contributions keep city/state only, expenditures keep no address at all.
